item.g:title: Honey Bros Premium Manuka Honey UMF 20+, MGO 850+, 250 g, New Zealand
item.g:description: 🏆 Ordered more than 500 times ⭐ Rated 4.9 out of 5 from 17 reviews New Zealand Manuka honey from the Honey Bros brand, graded UMF 20+ and MGO 850+, in a quarter-kilo jar (250 g). Thick and creamy, dark golden in colour, with a deep herbal taste and a light bitterness that Manuka lovers know from the first spoonful. 🔍 What do UMF 20+ and MGO 850+ mean? UMF stands for Unique Manuka Factor, a grading given by the New Zealand Manuka honey producers' association after testing the honey in accredited laboratories. MGO stands for methylglyoxal, the compound used to measure Manuka honey. A high grade: UMF 20+ and MGO 850+ on the jar. A single origin: produced and packed in New Zealand. Pure honey: 100% Manuka with no additives. In stock in our Saudi warehouse, so you do not wait for a shipment from New Zealand. 📋 Product specifications Specification Value Type Manuka honey from the Manuka bush nectar Origin New Zealand Brand Honey Bros Grade UMF 20+ , MGO 850+ Weight 250 g (quarter kilo) Ingredients 100% Manuka honey, no additives Texture and colour Thick and creamy, dark golden 🥄 How to enjoy it In a cup of warm water or tea once it has cooled a little. Over yoghurt and oats, or on buttered toast. Beside Saudi coffee and dates when hosting. A gift for someone who values fine honey. 🌿 From New Zealand to your home The Manuka bush grows in New Zealand, and bees make this honey from its nectar. It is harvested and packed there. We advise you to look for the UMF seal on any Manuka jar, and not to rely on an MGO number alone. 📦 How to store it Close the jar well after each use, keep it at room temperature away from sun and moisture, and use a dry spoon. It does not need a fridge. 🤝 Why order from Asal Al Jebal? We do not sell manufactured or pasteurised honey, and returns are accepted within 7 days. ❓ Frequently asked questions Is this genuine Manuka honey? It is 100% New Zealand Manuka honey from Honey Bros, graded UMF 20+ and MGO 850+. How long does a quarter kilo last? About 12 tablespoons, or two to three weeks at one teaspoon a day. Why does it taste different from usual honey? Manuka tastes deeply herbal with a light bitterness, and its body is thicker than most honeys, which comes from the nature of its nectar. Is it suitable for infants? No, honey should not be given to children under 12 months. When will my order arrive?
